Jupiter.1: Jupiter in its own place and in the second causes the acquisition of position, sons, wealth, and honor
Jupiter.2: Jupiter in its own place and in the second causes the acquisition of position, sons, wealth, and honor
Jupiter.3: in the third success with regard to victory and wealth
Jupiter.4: in the fourth the attainment of joy and happiness
Jupiter.5: in the fifth despondency, poverty, and wandering
Jupiter.6: in the sixth agitation because of one's enemies, sleepiness, fatigue, and disease
Jupiter.7: in the seventh and eighth the acquisition of food, women, good health, sons, and money
Jupiter.8: in the seventh and eighth the acquisition of food, women, good health, sons, and money
Jupiter.9: in the ninth it destroys one's intelligence and memory
Jupiter.10: in the tenth it gives position, glory, and wealth
Jupiter.11: in the eleventh Jupiter causes success with regard to acquisitions
Jupiter.12: and in the twelfth it gives weariness

Sun.1: Jupiter in the place of the Sun causes the acquisition of intelligence, friends, and money
Sun.2: in the second it gives wealth
Sun.3: in the third it produces illnesses, poverty, enemies, and losses
Sun.4: in the fourth status, fame, and renown
Sun.5: in the fifth Jupiter causes diseases, punishment by the king, and wandering
Sun.7: in the seventh the appearance of joy and happiness
Sun.8: in the eighth sickness and the loss of one's money
Sun.9: in the ninth success with regard to righteousness (dharma) and wealth, and happiness
Sun.10: in the tenth profit in one's activities, joy, and authority
Sun.11: in the eleventh the acquisition of garments and gold
Sun.12: and in the twelfth Jupiter gives enemies, fatigue, and grief

Saturn.1: Jupiter in the place of Saturn gives perturbation
Saturn.2: in the second it causes the loss of one's wealth
Saturn.3: in the third it gives the acquisition of lands, wealth, and money
Saturn.5: in the fifth it produces joy from one's sons and power
Saturn.6: in the sixth good qualities, authority, victory, and wealth
Saturn.7: in the seventh miseries, diseases, and illness
Saturn.8: in the eighth Jupiter causes sickness and takes away one's money
Saturn.9: in the ninth Jupiter gives the appearance of evil, and weariness
Saturn.10: in the tenth injuries, quarrels, and reproaches
Saturn.11: in the eleventh and twelfth vast possessions
Saturn.12: in the eleventh and twelfth vast possessions

Venus.1: Jupiter in the place of Venus causes mental anguish and despair
Venus.2: in the second it gives women and wealth
Venus.3: in the third it causes an increase in strife with one's wife and in her anger
Venus.4: in the fourth quarrels with one's elders (guru) and relatives
Venus.5: in the fifth wealth and the begetting of sons
Venus.6: in the sixth Jupiter causes the crushing of one's enemies, and wealth
Venus.7: in the seventh it gives quarrels with one's wife, wanderings, and delusion
Venus.8: in the eighth it takes away joy, happiness, and wealth
Venus.9: in the ninth Jupiter causes an increase in one's good qualities, money, and righteousness (dharma)
Venus.10: in the tenth it gives wealth
Venus.11: in the eleventh Jupiter gives the acquisition of women, wealth, and grain
Venus.12: and in the twelfth the loss of these

Mars.1: Jupiter in the place of Mars destroys one's foes
Mars.2: in the second it gives brilliance and joy
Mars.3: in the third it produces agitation and quarrels
Mars.4: in the fourth (the native) possesses friendship and honor
Mars.5: in the fifth it overcomes the fear of one's enemies
Mars.6: in the sixth it produces fatigue, misfortune, and old age
Mars.7: in the seventh diseases, enemies, and grief
Mars.8: in the eighth it destroys what pertains to victory and joy
Mars.9: in the ninth it takes away one's beauty and destroys one's wealth
Mars.10: in the tenth it produces position, good qualities, and prosperity
Mars.11: in the eleventh Jupiter causes the acquisition of lands and gold

Mercury.1: Jupiter in the place of Mercury causes the thriving of one's voice and intellect
Mercury.2: in the second an increase in one's honor
Mercury.3: in the third it destroys honor, happiness, and status
Mercury.4: in the fourth (the native) possesses honor, profits, and money
Mercury.5: in the fifth it destroys fame and wealth
Mercury.6: in the sixth it obstructs beauty, pleasure, and glory
Mercury.7: in the seventh Jupiter abets one's joy and good qualities
Mercury.8: in the eighth it causes soundness of one's voice and mind
Mercury.9: in the ninth it destroys one's voice and intellect
Mercury.10: in the tenth it gives the acquisition of righteousness ( dharma) and income
Mercury.11: in the eleventh Jupiter gives success with regard to knowledge, happiness, and wealth

Moon.1: Jupiter in the place of the Moon causes delusion, loss of money, the destruction of one's status and honor, fatigue, wandering, all sorts of diseases, opposition, and quarrels
Moon.2: in the second it gives position, sons, authority, and wealth
Moon.3: in the third Jupiter causes the loss of one's people and money, hindrance in one's business, wandering, weariness, and cheating
Moon.4: in the fourth contempt, a decrease in one's goods, reproach, the death of one's relatives, and anxiety
Moon.5: in the fifth it gives servants, clothes, position, gold, honor, and sons, and conquers one's foes
Moon.6: in the sixth Jupiter causes quarrels with one's relatives, disputes, terror, and the loss of the profits of one's activities
Moon.7: in the seventh it produces ( the enjoyment of) women, houses, food, and drink, handsomeness, and extremely profitable journeys
Moon.8: in the eighth Jupiter causes the destruction of one's wealth and relatives, diseases, fatigue, poverty, and quarrels
Moon.9: in the ninth Jupiter produces outstanding success with regard to one's sons, wife, lands, position, honor, and wealth
Moon.10: in the tenth it causes eye-diseases, the loss of one's goods, phlegmatic illnesses, difficulties, and the death of one's sons
Moon.11: in the eleventh Jupiter gives lands, houses, sons, women, gold, grain, clothes, and vehicles
Moon.12: and in the twelfth from the Moon it causes travel in foreign countries, weariness, and poverty

Ascendant.1: Jupiter in the ascendent gives gold, cows, horses, sons, lands, children, knowledge, sexual intercourse, position, glory, and food
Ascendant.2: in the second it produces the honor, happiness, and wealth of men (the natives)
Ascendant.3: in the third Jupiter causes the appearance of quarrels with one's relatives and one's enemies, of anger, reproach, and decline
Ascendant.4: in the fourth success with regard to one's own dharma, strings of pearls, houses, and money
Ascendant.5: in the fifth from the ascendent Jupiter gives dignity, honor, sons, fame, and wealth
Ascendant.6: in the sixth it establishes the bringing forth of good qualities, the acquisition of glory and wealth, the destruction of one's enemies, power, and beauty
Ascendant.7: in the seventh it produces food, women, clothes, perfume, garlands, and pleasure, and destroys disease
Ascendant.8: in the eighth Jupiter causes phlegmatic (diseases), old age, ( the bites of) snakes, wandering, imprisonment, and terror of one's enemies
Ascendant.9: in the ninth Jupiter causes the acquisition of position, money, knowledge, sons, and righteousness (dharma), and happiness
Ascendant.10: in the tenth authority, the acquisition of wealth and honor from kings, and success in business
Ascendant.11: in the eleventh Jupiter causes the acquisition of cows, lands, grain, clothes, gold, children, knowledge, houses, and food
Ascendant.12: and in the twelfth it gives profitless journeys and expenses
